request: Analyze GSE240131 for PMID 38370171 (Low-intensity exercise training improves systolic function of heart during metastatic melanoma-induced cachexia in mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, whole heart, DNBSEQ-T7 PE150, HISAT2 + featureCounts (S2.4.p1)
final.groups: 2x2: C (saline), E (exercise), T (B16F10), TE (B16F10 + exercise); n=3 libraries per group, each pooling hearts of two mice (FIG3 legend)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of low-intensity exercise training on the heart transcriptome of tumor-bearing (B16F10 cachectic) mice: TE vs T (S3.3.p1, FIG4)
planned_contrasts: T vs C (tumor effect; S3.3.p1: 2020 up, 741 genes in the heart-contraction set, stated as 'upregulated' but the named genes (Myh7b) are tumor-decreased)
TE vs T (exercise effect in tumor-bearing mice; S3.3.p1: 318 of the 741 and 1447 of the 2020 reversed by exercise)
E vs C (exercise effect in tumor-free mice; implied by FIG3 clusters and PCA, S3.2.p5; no DEG count)
final.paper_method: edgeR (S2.4.p1); test type and filtering not stated
final.paper_results: T vs C: 2020 up, 741 (heart-contraction overlap set base); TE vs T reverses 318 and 1447; named reversed genes Myh7b, Pde4d, Rnf207, Tmem65, Kcnj5 (S3.3.p1), Cacnb2 (S4.p3)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p1 design (4 wk treadmill, B16F10 i.v. from week 2), S2.4.p1 edgeR FC>=1.5 & p<0.05, S3.3.p1 DEG counts, FIG3 n=3 pooled libraries. Primary estimand is exercise within tumor-bearing mice, as in the title and S3.3.

checks: GEO samples: heart, male C57BL/6J, Saline/Exercise/B16F10 cells/B16F10 cells+Exercise, 3 each, matching the paper's 2x2 design and n=3
contact Binbin Liu, Xiamen University = corresponding author/institution

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, groups and n all match the paper. GEO extract_protocol says 'livers' and data_processing says 'Assembly: mm10' vs paper GRCm39; recorded as discrepancies, not ownership failures.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns C1..TE3 equal the suffix of the GEO title 'Heart, C1'; exact match on the derived key. grp = C/E/T/TE agrees with characteristics treatment (Saline/Exercise/B16F10 cells/B16F10 cells+Exercise).

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: featureCounts, 'raw counts'. Library sizes 8.8-13.3 M, median 96-213, about 7% of cells are non-integer (e.g. Ccna2 19.47): featureCounts fractional multi-mapping counts, i.e. estimated counts on the count scale, not FPKM/TPM. Paper input is the same featureCounts table (S2.4.p1). Rounded to integers before edgeR.

candidates.reason_rejected: pools tumor levels; the paper compares exercise within tumor status

candidates.value: 2x2 factorial with tumor:exercise interaction as primary
candidates.reason_rejected: paper reports pairwise edgeR DEG sets and their overlaps, not an interaction test

design.reasoning: Paper (S3.3.p1, FIG4) uses T vs C and TE vs T DEG sets; E vs C is the exercise effect in tumor-free mice (FIG3, S3.2.p5). TE vs T is primary. Data check: melanoma markers (Pmel, Tyrp1, Dct, Mlana, plus Mki67/Top2a) are 10^3-10^4-fold higher in T1 and T2 than in all other libraries and absent from all TE libraries, so T1/T2 contain metastatic tumor tissue; the TE vs T and T vs C contrasts mix cardiac change with tumor-cell content. The contrast remains identifiable (no batch aliasing), so it is run with this caveat rather than refused; E vs C is unaffected.

covariance.reasoning: Independent pooled libraries, one tissue, one sex, no batch or lane recorded. Tumor-tissue content in T1/T2 cannot be modelled as a covariate with n=3 (it is nearly a group property); recorded as a caveat instead.

final.method: edgeR (TMM, GLM quasi-likelihood F-test, inmoose), pairwise two-group fits
deviations: featureCounts fractional counts rounded to integers before edgeR (the executor requires integers)
paper does not state its edgeR test (exactTest vs QL) or filtering; QL F-test on all non-zero genes, each pair fitted on its own 6 samples

method.reasoning: Paper used edgeR (S2.4.p1); edgeR runs on these count-scale data. Two-group executor per pair keeps the paper's pairwise DEG sets.

threshold.reasoning: S2.4.p1: FC >= 1.5 and p-value < 0.05 (raw p) -> p < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= log2(1.5) = 0.5849625. Audit: BH FDR < 0.05, no FC rule.

caveats: T1 and T2 heart libraries contain melanoma tumor tissue (Pmel, Tyrp1, Dct, Mlana 10^3-10^4-fold above all other libraries; none in TE). TE vs T and T vs C therefore mix exercise/tumor effects on the heart with tumor-cell content; the paper's 'cell cycle and DNA replication' genes up by tumor and reversed by exercise (S3.3.p1) are consistent with this contamination.
Paper text says the tumor 'upregulated 741 genes' later reversed by exercise, but the named genes (Myh7b, Rnf207, Tmem65) are tumor-decreased; we read 741 as tumor-down genes.
n=3 pooled libraries per group; raw p threshold without FDR control.

study.reasoning: paper_counts T vs C = 2020 up + 741 down (S3.3.p1; 741 read as tumor-down). No total DEG count is given for TE vs T or E vs C; only overlaps 318/1447, computed post hoc from our tables.

discrepancies.data: named genes Myh7b/Rnf207/Tmem65 are lower in T than C and higher in TE
GEO extract_protocol says 'livers'; title/source say heart
